name: Raffaello Criscuoli
headline: International Private Banker & AI Systems Builder | AI Agents · Wealth Management · LATAM
summary: Hybrid banker and AI builder. 10 years advising HNW and UHNW Latin American clients on offshore investments and discretionary and advisory mandates (FINRA Series 7 and 66). Founder of The Petails, Inc., designing and operating a production system of AI agents and models (Claude, OpenAI image generation, Cloudflare) that sells, produces and delivers physical products to real customers, with human approval at the key checkpoints. Brings AI into the business: self-initiated an automated asset allocation engine for an entire banking team. Uses Claude Code, MCP and agents daily. U.S. and Chilean citizen; native Spanish, English.

experience.title: Founder & AI Systems Builder
bullets: Founded an AI-native company that creates personalized hardcover illustrated books about real pets; designed and operates the full system that sells, produces and delivers them to customers.

Built the Factory, a proprietary engine that writes each story with Claude (Anthropic API), generates the illustrations with the OpenAI image API through a generation queue with visual universes, a recurring animal cast and quality tiers, and composes the finished book.

Designed autonomous agents: Periquito, a conversational intake and sales agent with a customer-journey CRM that drafts follow-ups and recovers leads, and Castor, an SEO agent that writes and publishes articles.

Built the serverless platform on Cloudflare Workers (portal, admin, factory, intake chat, image queue, SEO, community) with D1, R2 and Cloudflare Access; integrated Shopify (webhooks, payment reconciliation, discount codes), Gelato print-on-demand, Twilio SMS, Gmail API and Meta Ads.

Created a versioned Prompt Bank (SemVer, canary and live releases via a pointer, test rounds before promotion) and an admin console for production, corrections, sales, customer journey, costs and real-device performance.

Migrated operations from Make and Google Sheets to a code-based engine with traceable deployments and documented rollback; designed human-in-the-loop approval for customer-facing content, corrections, prompt promotion, deploys and spend.

experience.title: AVP, International Banker & Financial Advisor
bullets: Managed 300+ client relationships with $140M in AUM as a dual-hat banker and financial advisor, driving consistent growth in investment and advisory accounts.

Provided brokerage and advisory services (non-discretionary and discretionary) across open-architecture products — stocks, mutual funds, ETFs and offshore investments — for individuals and Personal Investment Companies.
Specialized in offshore investment solutions for Latin American clients, with working knowledge of cross-border tax considerations.
Highest return on assets on the team; product leader in CBL, discretionary advisory accounts, client trading and unsolicited options strategies.
Delivered above-plan results in 2025, exceeding revenue and net-new-asset targets while absorbing 40+ additional client relationships without service disruption.

Self-initiated and built an automated asset allocation and proposal engine with Gemini for the whole banker team, cutting proposal turnaround by ~87% and recovering 8+ working weeks per advisor per year.
Built several self-initiated business-management dashboards.
